notes.title: Luna & Sol: Nightmare Ward – Preparing for Full Release
notes.content:
[h3]Luna & Sol: Nightmare Ward – Preparing for Full Release[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622243/b307153f44835eb4b4301eb5e702499facc0b624.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Hello players,
We are now entering the [b]final stages before the full release[/b]. To deliver the best possible experience, we’ve been refining gameplay, adding content, and polishing every detail.[/p][p][b]About the Game[/b]
[i]Luna & Sol: Nightmare Ward[/i] is a strategic defense game where Luna and Sol guard the [b]corrupted gate[/b] against endless waves of nightmares.[/p][list][*][p]Recruit allies, set traps and unique gimmicks to build your defense.[/p][/*][*][p]Use Luna and Sol’s [b]stylish action and powerful skills[/b] to defeat enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Face new challenges and strategies across diverse stages.[/p][/*][/list][p]The full release is not the end, but the beginning. More updates and improvements are planned, and your wishlist and support mean the world to us.[/p]
